name: LibreChat
hint: Open-source AI chat for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and more

ALLOW_REGISTRATION.title: Allow registration
ALLOW_REGISTRATION.description: The first account to sign up becomes the admin. Turn this off once your users have joined.

OPENAI_API_KEY.title: OpenAI API key
OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Keep user_provided to let each user enter their own key, or set one key for everyone.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.title: Anthropic API key
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Keep user_provided to let each user enter their own key, or set one key for everyone.

GOOGLE_KEY.title: Google Gemini API key
GOOGLE_KEY.description: Keep user_provided to let each user enter their own key, or set one key for everyone.

CONFIG_PATH.title: librechat.yaml URL
CONFIG_PATH.description: Optional. A librechat.yaml adds custom endpoints and settings; without one LibreChat runs on its defaults.
